entities.name: Emmanuel Philibert, Prince of Carignano

entities.summary: Emmanuel Philibert of Savoy, 2nd Prince of Carignano, was the son and heir of Thomas Francis, Prince of Carignano. He constructed the Palazzo Carignano in Turin.
